cases.name: sync_amplification
cases.definition: Bytes one replica receives per committed batch, divided by the encoded bytes of the matching rows plus the index deltas.
cases.action: Add per-scope materialized views at the authority. Change items 13 and 14.

cases.name: policy_cost
cases.definition: p99 evaluation time and steps per write at a pinned policy version, plus the RPC count for a single-prefix write.
cases.workload: r = 5 to 200, f = 1e2 to 1e5, cold and warm policy.
cases.action: Co-locate facts or widen the projection. Do not use 2PC.

cases.name: conflict_rate
cases.definition: Conflict divided by the sum of committed, rejected, and conflict. Queued writes are excluded. A retry counts once.
cases.action: Revisit the base-version check and the per-key FIFO guarantee. Publish the retry contract.

cases.name: cold_start
cases.definition: Seconds and bytes from an empty replica to a readable and searchable scope at a pinned version. Hydration and diff attach are included.
cases.workload: Scope 10 MB to 1 GB, native and wasm.
cases.action: Add a per-scope snapshot path before the freeze.

cases.name: read_p99
cases.definition: Replica latency at p50, p99, and p999 for a point read, one scope page, and one search page.
cases.workload: N varies 10x at fixed scope, warm and cold.
cases.action: Find the dataset walk in the plan or the index. Remove it.
